title: Context isolation in coding agent loops
summary: The longer I worked on a problem with a coding agent, the dumber it felt. My context window was a junk drawer. Here's the multi-role loop I built so plans, builds, and reviews each get their own clean context.
body_markdown: Same way you handle it with humans, you push back. The advantage with subagents is you can tell one its feedback sucks without burning a relationship. A clarifier might block on something obvious, a reviewer might confuse "different than I would do it" with "wrong," a boss might merge four mediocre complaints into one official mediocre complaint. I'd still rather get that annoyance up front than buried in a PR review cycle.
